Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task by equating “has worked in France since what year” with “started as a professor at CPT in Marseille,” narrowing the scope to a specific professorship. This conflation led to prioritizing CPT’s “Professor in Marseille since 2004,” which conflicts with the correct broader fact (“has worked in France since 2000”). This scope error risked steering the team toward the wrong year.
